details.name: EquilibriumConstant
details.description: Comprehensive equilibrium constant calculator: Kp/Kc conversion, Ka/Kb conjugate pairs, K from ΔG°, Kw vs temperature.

details.name: LeChatelierAnalyzer
details.description: Comprehensive Le Chatelier's principle analyzer: predict equilibrium shift direction, K value change, and quantitative analysis for concentration, pressure, temperature, inert gas, and catalyst disturbances.

details.name: GibbsMinimization
details.description: Minimize Gibbs free energy to find equilibrium composition for complex chemical systems using Lagrange multiplier method with element balance constraints.

details.name: Schrodinger3DSolver
details.description: Solve the 3D time-independent Schrödinger equation for hydrogen-like atoms. Compute energy levels, wavefunctions (radial × angular), probability densities, orbital shapes, and quantum mechanical observables.

details.name: SphericalHarmonics
details.description: Compute spherical harmonics Y_l^m(θ, φ): values (real/imaginary/modulus), probability density, angular momentum eigenvalues, normalization, and orthogonality properties.

details.name: RadialDistribution
details.description: Compute radial distribution function D(r)=r²|R_nl(r)|² for hydrogen-like atoms: most probable radius, mean radius, radial nodes, probability in spherical shells, cumulative distribution, and radial moments.
